alternatives.option: Keep linear odd calculation (1x, 3x, 5x...) in code and update docs/enum name to match.
alternatives.whyRejected: Renaming the enum member from Fibonacci to LinearOdd would break public API compatibility, and docs explicitly specify true Fibonacci.

alternatives.option: Keep 250 ms default in code and update resilience.md documentation to match.
alternatives.whyRejected: resilience.md default strategy table explicitly documents 256 ms as canonical.

fields.consequences: DataConnectionConfigurationBase and SimpleConnection now produce true Fibonacci retry backoff delays (1x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 8x, 13x...) and default to 256 ms, aligning code and documentation.
fields.context: DataConnectionConfigurationBase.cs computed (2n-1) * retryInterval (linear odd steps) under the default Fibonacci enum member, while resilience.md specified true Fibonacci (previous two combined). Separately, code used DefaultRetryInterval = 250 ms while resilience.md documented 256 ms.
fields.decision: Implement true Fibonacci sequence in code for SequenceLengthening.Fibonacci (1x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 8x...) and set DefaultRetryInterval to 256 ms in DataConnectionConfigurationBase and SimpleConnection.
fields.title: B2: Reconcile Fibonacci Retry Curve and RetryInterval Default
